body: FRONT_DOOR_FUNNEL.md §7 step 1: CreateAgent now inserts status=PENDING instead of ACTIVE; added GrantAgentPermission/RevokeAgentPermission + maybeActivateAgent helper that flips PENDING->ACTIVE only once both a credential and a permission exist. Back Office UI updated (credential/permission display, grant/revoke forms, one-time secret reveal). Also fixed a real pre-existing bug found via testing: mysqlToSQLite didn't handle bare TIMESTAMP/ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP (no (6) precision), silently breaking fresh SQLite bootstraps at 202606180001_local_users.sql since the S158-03 revert. 4 new store tests pass against a real in-memory SQLite store with real migrations. Commit: pending. Unblocks progress toward EMILY/BACKLOG.md S23-01b (steps 5-6, nginx/subdomain, still open).
title: Close /admin/agents gap: PENDING→ACTIVE agent lifecycle
